summary: Well-structured solution with good error handling, proper permissions, and sensible workflow design. Key issues: classification logic duplicated across bash pure functions (unit-tested per TDD) and jq filter (production), requiring coordination on future changes. All scripts use set -euo pipefail, quoted variables, clear error messages. Workflow correctly pins actions, enforces least-privilege, uses appropriate triggers (push/pull_request/schedule/workflow_dispatch) and job dependencies. Minor: assumes POSIX date and script execute permissions, jq filter is complex but documented.
